hero.headline: Bath Remodeling Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for bath remodeling solutions.

overview: Bath Remodeling Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Real-time bath remodeling web leads delivered to your CRM the moment a homeowner requests an estimate, with inbound call and live transfer options.

Live transfers extend the web-lead program with a fully qualified phone connection. Where a web lead is delivered for the sales team to work, a live transfer is pre-screened by our team, which confirms property ownership, service area, project scope and budget before warm-transferring the call. Remodelers often pair the two: web leads for volume across a market, and live transfers for the highest-intent homeowners who are ready to schedule an in-home estimate right away.

This product is suited to web leads businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of bath remodeling consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners aged 35 and older who own a single-family home and are planning a bath or shower project. The strongest segments are owners of older homes with dated bathrooms, households seeking safer, more accessible bathing such as walk-in tubs, and homeowners wanting a tub-to-shower conversion who submit an online request and have budget set aside.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: submitted an online bath or shower remodel request; interested in a walk-in tub or accessible bathing; wants a tub-to-shower conversion; has an outdated bathroom in need of renovation.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "bathroom remodel quote" and "walk in tub installation", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard bath remodeling criteria include: owns the home where the work will be performed; located in the remodeler's service area; has a defined bath or shower project scope; has budget available and is planning to move forward; age 18 or older and a decision maker for the household; provided tcpa consent for follow-up contact.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: How fast are bath remodeling web leads delivered?
faq.a: Leads are delivered in real time through direct CRM or API integration, so a homeowner's request reaches your system within seconds of submission while they are still comparing companies.

faq.q: Can leads be focused on a specific project type?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery can prioritise walk-in tubs, tub-to-shower conversions, full renovations or shower replacements, and can be filtered to the ZIP codes your crews serve.

faq.q: Can I combine web leads with calls and transfers?
faq.a: Yes. Web leads are the core product, and inbound calls and live transfers can be added alongside them so you blend real-time leads with live phone connections in one program.
